findings.fact: requirements_entry orders stage-close(requirements) followed by resume, while the generated TODO requires atomic stage-transition for every non-terminal boundary and reserves stage-close for a terminal stage.
findings.baseline_effect: The initial requirements attempt closed at item_15; resume returned repair_required; the first stage-transition failed because no requirements attempt was open; a repair attempt had to be opened and atomically transitioned.

findings.fact: The resume packet emitted after the premature close reported an acceptance-closure error and disclosed stage_authority_route.stage=apply although model had not been opened.
findings.baseline_effect: The Agent loaded four later-stage references before model opened and reread the 345-line development guide three more times plus backend-model once more.

findings.fact: The fresh-context test asserts that sync and route actions exist, but does not assert the only legal atomic requirements-to-model transition, absence of stage-close, or suppression of later authority when the boundary is incomplete.

Requirements closure used sync, two list calls, and 15 per-gate attach operations. The Agent declared all rows passed against one PRD artifact; no single typed compiler receipt simultaneously proves PRD structure, traceability closure, demand-profile coverage, identity binding, and the atomic stage boundary.

The PRD template header tells reference-mode authors to see development-guide.md although requirements_entry explicitly defers that whole guide. The requirements authority already defines reference mode, so this pointer is unnecessary current-stage leakage.

always_once: accepted current source authority such as requirements.md or immutable accepted design references
current TODO header plus requirements and domain-truth sections only

conditional.trigger: a structurally parsed accepted requirement contains a calculation, historical fact, settlement, correction, or reversal obligation

conditional.authority: frontend evidence files in the documented evidence order
conditional.trigger: resolver frontend evidence manifest proves one or more regular frontend/src files

quality_invariants_retained: all routes and backend-bound operations dispositioned
one traceability row per accepted backend-bound requirement
every write closes authorization, error, transaction, idempotency, durable effect, and acceptance proof
domain truth ownership, snapshot, trace, correction, consumer, and report source remain closed
only typed business_blocker ambiguity blocks the smallest affected slice
acceptance journeys retain formal actor/context, isolated setup, positive and denied/conflict oracles, unchanged-state proof, durable reconciliation, and restart/replay proof

compiler_rules: Parse only stable PRD headings, table identities, explicit requirement IDs, classifications, and typed cells; never scan prose for capability keywords.
Reject unknown demand kinds and any requirement, journey, permission, or structural reference that does not join to the accepted PRD.

Require every confirmed/recommended backend-bound requirement and every write/report/export/schedule/notification/integration row to be covered; frontend_only rows must not select backend capability references.
A valid business_blocker produces readiness=blocked only for the exact joined demand rows and retains every unrelated row as readiness=ready; malformed or unbounded slices fail closed.
Map closed demand kinds to capability reference keys using the versioned CLI registry; the Agent cannot provide or override capability file paths.
Emit IDs, structural pointers, selected reference keys, counts, and hashes only; never copy PRD prose or matrices into the packet.

git_contract.snapshot: an evaluator-owned immutable commit/tree containing accepted source authority and PRD output
git_contract.cleanliness_capture: sha256 of canonical git status --porcelain=v2 --untracked-files=all output

consumer_contract: Clone the immutable checkpoint tree into a new empty experiment workspace with a new session ID and no database or Runtime state.
Recompute every identity field before opening model; mismatch or an unavailable comparison fails closed and requires a fresh requirements run.

A later-stage candidate may differ outside the recorded requirements-contract closure only when a machine diff manifest proves every requirements-relevant Skill/CLI contract hash unchanged; inability to prove that equality fails closed.
Do not reuse TODO attempt ledgers, Gate locks, receipts other than the immutable accepted requirements receipt, model files, database state, or Runtime state.
The model experiment records parent_checkpoint_id and reports stage-local timing only.

change_request.change: Replace close_requirements_attempt + route_next_stage with one final requirements-finalize recipe action that validates and atomically transitions requirements to model. Retain the TODO rule that stage-close is terminal-only. Never disclose stage_authority_route until the atomic boundary succeeds.

Merge sync + two lists + 15 Agent-driven attach calls into one fail-closed requirements-finalize command. It must validate PRD structure and all existing requirements/domain-truth predicates, compile the typed demand profile, bind the deterministic requirements identity, emit one stage receipt, then perform the existing atomic stage transition under one lock. Remove the PRD template's current-stage pointer to development-guide.md because the focused requirements authority already defines reference mode. No completeness, traceability, domain-truth, blocker, or acceptance-contract predicate may be removed or weakened.

Add a compact structurally typed PRD demand index and machine compiler. Capability reference keys come only from the versioned CLI registry. Bind the packet to accepted PRD/requirements/frontend/authority/receipt identities and disclose only selected model-stage references after transition; do not keyword-guess, copy full PRD content, or accept free-form feature flags.

Allow evaluator-controlled stage-local model experiments to import an immutable accepted requirements checkpoint into an independent blank workspace. Validate all upstream hashes, requirements-relevant Skill/CLI contract closure, receipt, demand profile, PostgreSQL driver, Git tree, and clean status before opening model. Explicitly reject checkpoint import in fresh-E2E mode.

Replace presence-only recipe assertions with exact ordered action assertions and negative assertions for stage-close/resume. Add atomicity, authority-suppression, typed-profile coverage/identity, checkpoint invalidation, PostgreSQL-first, and timing-mode separation tests.
